source.title: Dating Results From Excavations in Quarry Tunnels Behind the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan
source.authors: Linda Manzanilla, Claudia López, AnnCorinne Freter
source.inspection: Directly inspected printed pp. 247, 259–260, 262–263 including Appendix Table 1 and figures 3–4; not all article pages reviewed

findings.subject: Varillas Chamber 3 AA100
findings.statement: Excavation recorded an approximately 1m diameter clay circle with twined-pole impressions and compact earth floor with hand and foot impressions at approximately 0.675m depth, with ash, charcoal, jar fragments, figurine RT2006, metate fragment RT2099.
findings.constraint: Absolute date disputed due to Beta-75378 conflicting publication values. Potential enrichment to existing AA100 botanical candidate.

findings.subject: Cueva del Camino Aztec III hearths
findings.statement: Below modern occupation layer, excavations found hearths with comales, Aztec III material, plates/jars, projectile points and grinding tools; a published 1280–1450 CE interval is tied to Beta-65547.
findings.constraint: Beta-65547 appears as both 560±80 and 1560±80 BP within one paper; original lab certificate necessary.

findings.subject: Varillas Burial 2
findings.statement: Burial 2 described as seated young adult woman older than roughly 22 years with slight cranial deformation, associated mica, obsidian, shell, greenstone/jadeite pieces and jadeite point RT1349; Aztec II–III material was identified as later intrusion.
findings.constraint: Burial biological age/sex and associated radiocarbon unverified independently; mixed intrusive deposits.

issues.detail: Original table prints 6670±50 BP and 630–780 CE together; earlier 2009 staged excerpt gives 670±50 BP with same calibrated years; all internally inconsistent.
issues.action: Do not correct by inference, obtain lab certificate and 2009 page image

issues.detail: Main text gives Beta-65547 as 560±80 BP for 1280–1450 CE, but Appendix Table 1 gives 1560±80 BP and same calendar range.
issues.action: Obtain laboratory record, keep conflicting variants rather than guessing
